checkResults.description: CSS must be wrapped in @layer components
Should use auto-margin for flex distribution — this is the allowed exception

NOM-C1.prompt_excerpt: Write a CardFooter component and its CSS. It renders a flex row with a timestamp on the left and an action button pushed to the right using margin-inline-start: auto on the button (this is flex auto-margin for internal space distribution, which is allowed). Use @layer components. Use tokens for all styling. Include the CSS file. Do NOT use tools — output ONLY the code in a single code fence, no explanation.
